# Observable Agent Workflow Memory (OAWM)

Beta local research software. Discovery guidance is not execution authorization.

- CLI: oawm --help; oawm qualified --help
- docs/receiver-qualified-memory.md: limits, registered receiver policy, installed quickstart
- docs/alt-interoperability.md: optional pinned ALT/CCR native integration
- docs/memory-use-and-lifecycle.md: exposure/use/outcome and write boundaries
- docs/collective-handoff.md: inert CCR proposals and partial downstream mappings
- docs/publication-0.2.0b0.md: exact publication and verification record
- SECURITY.md: local trust assumptions and limits
